justification: The implementation of the European Climate Law's target of reducing greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 will reinforce the Sustainable Transport Investment Plan's goal of supporting specific renewable and low-carbon fuels for aviation and waterborne transport, as a low-carbon transport sector is essential for achieving the EU's climate objectives.

The European Climate Law's target of reducing greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 will be indivisible from the Clean Industrial Deal's objective of delivering a competitive, low-carbon EU industry, as the industry's transition to a low-carbon economy is crucial for achieving the EU's climate goals.

The Farm to Fork Strategy's goal of reducing the environmental and climate impact of the EU food system will enable the Sustainable Transport Investment Plan's objective of promoting sustainable land transport modes, as sustainable food systems and sustainable transport are interconnected.

The European Climate Law's target of reducing greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 will reinforce the Nature Restoration Law's goal of restoring damaged ecosystems, as ecosystem restoration can help achieve the EU's climate objectives.

The Circular Economy Action Plan's goal of reducing waste and increasing recycling may counteract the Sustainable Transport Investment Plan's objective of promoting low-carbon fuels for transport, as the plan may lead to increased energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions from transportation.

The European Climate Law's target of reducing greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 will be indivisible from the REPowerEU Plan's objective of increasing the use of renewable energy and reducing the EU's dependence on fossil fuels, as a low-carbon energy mix is essential for achieving the EU's climate goals.

The Farm to Fork Strategy's goal of reducing the environmental and climate impact of the EU food system will enable the REPowerEU Plan's objective of increasing the use of renewable energy, as sustainable food systems and renewable energy are interconnected.

The European Climate Law's target of reducing greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030 will reinforce the EU Soil Strategy for 2030's goal of protecting and sustainably managing soils, as soil health is crucial for achieving the EU's climate objectives.

The Circular Economy Action Plan's goal of reducing waste and increasing recycling may constrain the EU Soil Strategy for 2030's objective of protecting soils, as increased recycling and waste management may lead to soil pollution and degradation.
